help.via: its target: a BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6"

mod.when: Start of your Fight phase, selected by its target, a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6" (until the end of the turn)

source.text:
WHEN: Start of your Fight phase.
TARGET: One **BLOOD LEGIONS** unit from your army.
EFFECT: Select one friendly **WORLD EATERS** unit within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in your **WORLD EATERS** unit have the **[LANCE]** ability. If the Daemonic Rage ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase those melee weapons also have the **[TWIN-LINKED]** ability.

source.implements: which footnotes a unit gets: its own, detachment rules matching its keywords (and the parts of a detachment rule whose needs it meets), auras, stratagems it is eligible for, and those another unit of the list is the target of whose effect changes its attacks (helpedBy); Lance (+1 to wound after a charge); Plunging Fire for TOWERING (22.05)

judgement.code: const helpedBy = (u, a) => allStratagems(a).filter(s => s.help && matches(s.help.to, u) && (a || army()).units.some(x => x !== u && matches(s.help.by, x)));

source.implements: a stratagem whose TARGET is another unit of the list (help.by) and whose effect changes this unit's attacks (help.to: Daemonic Fury, a BLOOD LEGIONS target selecting a friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 6"): listed on this unit's datasheet with who is its target, its footnote on this unit
